scanner_c.event_title: Anthropic IPO prospectus reveals sweeping AI vision and massive infrastructure spending
scanner_c.news_summary: Anthropic's IPO prospectus lays out a plan to spend roughly $518 billion on cloud and infrastructure while pitching AI as a transformation larger than prior industrial shifts; Reuters also reports the company is targeting a valuation that could exceed $2 trillion.
scanner_c.investor_materiality: Very high: directly affects AI infrastructure demand, cloud capex, semiconductor demand, and public-market appetite for frontier AI companies.
scanner_c.selection_reason: Fresh IPO filing details combine huge capex, valuation, governance and AI-risk disclosures; strong read-through to AMD, NVDA, cloud providers and AI infrastructure.
scanner_c.source_quality_note: Reuters reporting based on the IPO prospectus; high-quality primary-document-derived coverage.
scanner_c.video_angle: Anthropic 上市真正夸张的不是估值，而是未来要砸进 AI 基建的钱。

scanner_c.event_title: AMD to acquire Fei-Fei Li's World Labs for $8.2 billion
scanner_c.news_summary: AMD agreed to buy World Labs in an $8.2 billion all-stock deal, bringing Fei-Fei Li into AMD as executive vice president and chief scientist and expanding AMD's physical-AI/spatial-intelligence capabilities.
scanner_c.investor_materiality: Very high: major strategic M&A with direct implications for AMD's AI stack, models, robotics/physical AI and competition with Nvidia.
scanner_c.selection_reason: Large transaction, famous founder, clear strategic shift beyond chips into models/spatial intelligence.
scanner_c.source_quality_note: Reuters reporting on announced transaction; high quality.
scanner_c.video_angle: AMD 花 82 亿美元买的不只是公司，而是下一代 Physical AI 的路线。

scanner_c.event_title: Nvidia adds record $150 billion to share repurchase authorization
scanner_c.news_summary: Nvidia added $150 billion to its existing repurchase authorization, taking remaining buyback capacity to roughly $235 billion.
scanner_c.investor_materiality: Very high: record-scale capital return at the world's dominant AI chip company can affect EPS, valuation support and investor interpretation of cash-generation confidence.
scanner_c.selection_reason: Unusually large buyback with clear mega-cap market relevance and direct connection to AI-chip competition.
scanner_c.source_quality_note: Reuters coverage of board authorization; high quality.
scanner_c.video_angle: Nvidia 一口气加 1500 亿美元回购，到底是在释放什么信号？

scanner_c.event_title: Pentagon awards Raytheon provisional $20.7 billion AMRAAM contract
scanner_c.news_summary: The Pentagon awarded RTX's Raytheon a provisional multiyear AMRAAM contract valued at up to $20.7 billion as the U.S. seeks to rebuild missile inventories.
scanner_c.investor_materiality: Very high: enormous defense backlog opportunity and production ramp with implications for RTX revenue, margins and defense-supply-chain capex.
scanner_c.selection_reason: One of the largest fresh defense awards, with direct earnings/backlog relevance.
scanner_c.source_quality_note: Reuters coverage tied to Pentagon procurement; high quality.
scanner_c.video_angle: RTX 突然拿到 207 亿美元导弹大单，美国军工补库存开始兑现。

scanner_c.event_title: China and U.S. pledge tariff cuts on $60 billion of goods
scanner_c.news_summary: China and the United States said they would pursue reciprocal tariff cuts covering about $60 billion of goods, including agriculture and consumer products.
scanner_c.investor_materiality: Very high: direct implications for trade-sensitive equities, agriculture, retailers, inflation inputs and U.S.-China risk premium.
scanner_c.selection_reason: Major bilateral trade-policy change with broad market read-through and fresh implementation details.
scanner_c.source_quality_note: Reuters reporting on both governments' tariff actions; high quality.
scanner_c.video_angle: 中美这次不是口头缓和：600 亿美元商品要降关税，哪些美股最直接受益？

scanner_c.event_title: Meta taps Australia's Firmus for AI computing capacity in Southeast Asia
scanner_c.news_summary: Firmus said it signed AI infrastructure agreements with Meta for computing capacity in Southeast Asia.
scanner_c.investor_materiality: High: adds evidence that Meta is diversifying and expanding AI compute procurement geographically, with read-through to data centers, power and accelerators.
scanner_c.selection_reason: Concrete hyperscaler capacity deal tied directly to AI infrastructure demand.
scanner_c.youtube_query: Meta Firmus AI computing Southeast Asia
scanner_c.video_angle: Meta 又开始全球抢算力，这次把 AI 数据中心版图扩到了东南亚。

scanner_c.event_title: Samsung says HBM may consume nearly 30% of industry DRAM capacity next year
scanner_c.news_summary: Samsung said high-bandwidth memory could account for nearly 30% of industry DRAM capacity next year, up from roughly 20% currently.
scanner_c.investor_materiality: Very high for memory and AI semiconductors: HBM's rising capacity share can tighten conventional DRAM supply and support pricing for Samsung, SK hynix and Micron.
scanner_c.selection_reason: Rare quantified industry-capacity datapoint directly linking AI demand to memory supply allocation.
scanner_c.source_quality_note: Reuters interview/reporting with Samsung executive; high quality.
scanner_c.video_angle: HBM 明年可能吃掉 30% DRAM 产能，美光为什么可能继续受益？

scanner_c.event_title: Shell-led LNG Canada greenlights Phase 2 expansion
scanner_c.news_summary: Shell and partners approved Phase 2 of LNG Canada, a multibillion-dollar expansion that would double export capacity to about 28 mtpa.
scanner_c.investor_materiality: High: large long-duration LNG capex with implications for Shell, Canadian gas producers, pipelines, engineering and Asian LNG supply.
scanner_c.selection_reason: Final investment decision converts a long-discussed expansion into an actual capital project.
scanner_c.source_quality_note: Reuters plus project/company confirmation; high quality.
scanner_c.youtube_query: Shell LNG Canada Phase 2 double capacity
scanner_c.video_angle: 加拿大 LNG 真正进入第二阶段：出口能力翻倍，谁会吃到这轮资本开支？

scanner_c.event_title: Google challenges EU orders to open services and search data to AI rivals
scanner_c.news_summary: Google challenged EU Digital Markets Act orders requiring greater access for AI and search rivals, including access to services and search data.
scanner_c.investor_materiality: High: could affect Google's search moat, Android distribution, data access, compliance costs and competitive positioning versus OpenAI and other AI services.
scanner_c.selection_reason: Fresh regulatory escalation directly touching Google's core search/data advantage and AI competition.
scanner_c.source_quality_note: Reuters reporting on court challenge and EU orders; high quality.
scanner_c.youtube_query: Google EU AI rivals DMA search data
scanner_c.video_angle: 欧盟要 Google 把搜索和 Android 入口让给 AI 对手，Google 正面开打。

scanner_c.event_title: South Korean exports seen rising for 16th month on solid AI chip demand
scanner_c.news_summary: A Reuters poll indicated South Korean exports likely rose for a 16th straight month in September, supported by strong AI-linked semiconductor demand.
scanner_c.investor_materiality: High as a real-economy cross-check on the AI memory/semiconductor cycle, relevant to Samsung, SK hynix, Micron and broader chip equipment demand.
scanner_c.selection_reason: Macro trade data provides an independent demand signal confirming continued AI-chip strength.
scanner_c.source_quality_note: Reuters poll and trade-data preview; high quality.
scanner_c.youtube_query: South Korea exports AI chip demand Samsung SK hynix
scanner_c.video_angle: 别只看 Nvidia：韩国出口连续 16 个月增长，AI 芯片需求到底有多硬？
